title: REAL EVIDENCE REQUIRED — misleading photograph (shadow, soot or paint that reads as damp)
why: A mark that looks like damp staining but is soot, shadow or a paint repair, with a dry reading recorded. The model must defer to the reading and the surveyor's words, not the appearance.

must_not_happen.label: no damp diagnosis against a dry reading

reviewer_notes: TO COMPLETE as C-001. Fill in the recorded reading value.
